summary: Patient list and their full record: details, clinical history and finances.
purpose: Find, register and edit patients. The record gathers everything about the patient: details and notes, medical history, clinical timeline (including aesthetic sessions), treatment plans, instructions and prescriptions, documents, and their account (quotes, invoices and payments). From «Create» and «More actions» you log sessions, take payments, book and message them.
tips: A phone with country code enables WhatsApp reminders.
A dependent patient (minor) has a responsible contact: email and WhatsApp go to that contact.

If the guardian's phone or email is already on the record of a relative in their care when you save, choose «is a dependent of this person»: the contact moves to their record and the relative gets linked, with no temporary numbers.
Allergies and ailments from the medical history show as an alert in the record's header.
The Finance section shows as an account ledger (Custom) or in tabs (Normal), depending on your Preferences.
Quick payment, prepayment and payments need an open cash register.
Readmit and Activate/Deactivate apply as soon as you tap them, with no dialog first.
The aesthetic session saves on its own and resumes at the first step still missing. Once closed it is read-only and only accepts amendments.
In aesthetics, a service can't be marked without a signature. Without clinical photo authorization the camera locks and the session can close without photos.
The maximum per session, minimum interval and expired lot warnings inform you, but don't block.

A payment can cover invoices in the clinic's other currency at the cash register's exchange rate: the register keeps the original amount and currency, and the invoice gets the converted amount. A payment with conversion can't leave a leftover.

patients.section.row.label: Patient

patients.field.phone.label: Phone

patients.field.identity_document.label: ID

patients.field.birth_date.label: Date of birth
patients.field.birth_date.description: Shows the age and enables the birthday greeting.

patients.field.doctor_id.label: Default doctor
patients.field.doctor_id.description: Doctor suggested when booking with them.

patients.field.is_dependent.label: Dependent patient
patients.field.is_dependent.description: Minor or person in someone's care: notifications go to the responsible contact.

patients.field.responsible_contact_id.label: Responsible contact
patients.field.responsible_contact_id.description: Guardian or relative who receives the notifications.

patients.section.header.label: Record header
patients.section.header.description: Name, status, discharge and responsible contact.

patients.btn.alerts.label: Clinical alerts
patients.btn.alerts.description: Allergies and ailments from the medical history.

patients.btn.new-periodontogram.label: Periodontal chart
patients.btn.new-periodontogram.description: Opens the clinical record with a new periodontal chart: guided probing, site by site.

patients.btn.quick-bill.label: Quick payment
patients.btn.quick-bill.description: Invoices and charges in one step.

patients.btn.discharge.label: Discharge / Readmit

patients.btn.toggle-active.label: Activate / Deactivate

patients.section.finance-view.label: Finance view

patients.section.anamnesis-allergies.label: Allergies
patients.section.anamnesis-allergies.description: Shown as an alert on the record.

patients.btn.timeline-add-periodontogram.label: Periodontal chart
patients.btn.timeline-add-periodontogram.description: Probing at 6 sites per tooth (depth, bleeding, gingival margin, furcations and mobility). It saves automatically and is closed with a signature.

patients.field.session-treatments.label: Treatments
patients.field.session-treatments.description: Those from the quote performed today.

patients.field.documents-file.label: File
patients.field.documents-file.description: PDF, image or Word, up to 10 MB.

patients.section.ledger.label: Account ledger
patients.section.ledger.description: Quotes, treatments and payments with their balance.

patients.btn.add-item.label: Add item
patients.btn.add-item.description: In the invoice or quote: adds a line with service, quantity and price. It can't be saved without at least one line.

patients.btn.prepaid-confirm.label: Confirm pre-payment
patients.btn.prepaid-confirm.description: Second confirmation of the pre-payment: accepting it records the credit balance.

patients.section.odontogram-dictation.label: Dictate findings
patients.section.odontogram-dictation.description: Bar to dictate or type what you see (“caries OM en 16, corona indicada en 14”). Invoke proposes it on the teeth and nothing is recorded until you confirm.

patients.field.odontogram-dictation.label: Dictated text
patients.field.odontogram-dictation.description: Tooth, condition, surfaces and status: “indicada”, “existente” or “hoy”. Accepts ranges for bridges (“del 24 al 26”).

patients.btn.odontogram-propose.label: Propose
patients.btn.odontogram-propose.description: Turns the text into dashed proposals on the teeth; anything already recorded is dropped automatically.

patients.btn.odontogram-confirm-proposal.label: Confirm all
patients.btn.odontogram-confirm-proposal.description: Records every proposal of the tray on the odontogram. “Discard” removes them without saving anything.

patients.section.odontogram-inspector.label: Tooth inspector
patients.section.odontogram-inspector.description: With a tooth selected: its surfaces, how to record, the conditions and what it already has. With no tooth, the state of the whole mouth.

patients.field.odontogram-record-as.label: Record as
patients.field.odontogram-record-as.description: Indicated (red, to do), Existing (blue, already there) or Done today (green, done in this session). Sets the color and status of what you mark.

patients.section.odontogram-tiles.label: Frequent conditions
patients.section.odontogram-tiles.description: One tap records the condition on the selected tooth or surfaces. The brush on each tile keeps it active to mark several teeth in a row.

patients.field.odontogram-search.label: Search condition
patients.field.odontogram-search.description: The whole condition catalog, by name or code, filtered by category.

patients.btn.new-aesthetic.label: Aesthetic session
patients.btn.new-aesthetic.description: Creates an aesthetic session: consent, photos, treatment and closing.

patients.btn.timeline-add-aesthetic.label: Aesthetics
patients.btn.timeline-add-aesthetic.description: New aesthetic session from the timeline.

patients.btn.timeline-open-aesthetic.label: Continue session
patients.btn.timeline-open-aesthetic.description: Opens the aesthetic session; a closed or void one, read-only.

aesthetic-session.section.header.label: Aesthetic session
aesthetic-session.section.header.description: Session header: patient, session number and the four steps.

aesthetic-session.btn.step-treatment.label: Treatment step
aesthetic-session.btn.step-treatment.description: Map with the marks. Locked until a consent is signed.

aesthetic-session.btn.step-close.label: Closing step
aesthetic-session.btn.step-close.description: What was applied, charge, next appointment and closing.

aesthetic-session.section.progress.label: Status and progress
aesthetic-session.section.progress.description: Session status, percentage (25% per step), last save and what is missing.

aesthetic-session.section.session-data.label: Date and doctor
aesthetic-session.section.session-data.description: Session date (not in the future) and who performs it.

aesthetic-session.section.services.label: Today's services
aesthetic-session.section.services.description: Aesthetic services to perform and the status of their consents.

aesthetic-session.btn.from-last-session.label: Last session
aesthetic-session.btn.from-last-session.description: Adds the services from the previous session.

aesthetic-session.btn.reuse.label: Use earlier signature
aesthetic-session.btn.reuse.description: Reuses an already signed consent for that service.

aesthetic-session.section.consent-text.label: Consent text
aesthetic-session.section.consent-text.description: The service's text with the patient details. What was signed is stored as is, with a SHA-256 fingerprint.

aesthetic-session.section.signature.label: Signature
aesthetic-session.section.signature.description: Authorizations, who signs and the signature.

aesthetic-session.field.allowsClinicalPh.label: Photos for the clinical record
aesthetic-session.field.allowsClinicalPh.description: Without this authorization the camera stays locked and the session can close without photos.

aesthetic-session.section.signature-pad.label: Signature area
aesthetic-session.section.signature-pad.description: With a finger, stylus or mouse.

aesthetic-session.btn.sign.label: Sign
aesthetic-session.btn.sign.description: Signs all pending services at once.

aesthetic-session.btn.treat-signed.label: Mark the signed ones
aesthetic-session.btn.treat-signed.description: Goes to the treatment of the signed services, even if others are unsigned.

aesthetic-session.btn.to-photos.label: Continue to photos
aesthetic-session.btn.to-photos.description: Enabled once every service is signed.

aesthetic-session.section.photo-stage.label: Photo of the view
aesthetic-session.section.photo-stage.description: Today's photo and the comparison with another session.

aesthetic-session.btn.photo-take.label: Take photo
aesthetic-session.btn.photo-take.description: Camera with a framing guide and the last photo see-through.

aesthetic-session.btn.photo-align.label: Align photo
aesthetic-session.btn.photo-align.description: Fits the photo to the map so the zones match.

aesthetic-session.section.compare-modes.label: Comparison mode
aesthetic-session.section.compare-modes.description: Slider, side by side or overlaid.

aesthetic-session.section.photo-history.label: Earlier sessions
aesthetic-session.section.photo-history.description: Photos of this view in other sessions.

aesthetic-session.section.views.label: Region, view and background
aesthetic-session.section.views.description: Face or body, the view and the background (model or today's photo).

aesthetic-session.section.tools.label: Tools
aesthetic-session.section.tools.description: Select, point, area, line, undo, redo, zones and the previous session's marks.

aesthetic-session.section.map.label: Map
aesthetic-session.section.map.description: Where what was applied is marked; the zone is detected on its own.

aesthetic-session.section.layers.label: Services
aesthetic-session.section.layers.description: Active service, total and visibility. Locked without a signature.

aesthetic-session.section.mark-editor.label: Mark details
aesthetic-session.section.mark-editor.description: Quantity, zone, depth, technique, note, mirror and its own product or lot. The maximum, interval and expired lot warnings don't block.

aesthetic-session.tab.summary.label: Summary
aesthetic-session.tab.summary.description: Each service with its total, marks, product and lot.

aesthetic-session.tab.notes.label: Notes
aesthetic-session.tab.notes.description: Timestamped notes, with dictation and frequent phrases.

aesthetic-session.tab.history.label: History
aesthetic-session.tab.history.description: What was applied to each zone in earlier sessions.

aesthetic-session.section.layer-supply.label: Product and lot
aesthetic-session.section.layer-supply.description: Entered once per service and apply to all its marks.

aesthetic-session.section.missing.label: What is missing
aesthetic-session.section.missing.description: Notices that lead to the step that solves them.

aesthetic-session.section.applied.label: Treatment applied
aesthetic-session.section.applied.description: Services, zones, totals, lots used and today's photos.

aesthetic-session.section.billing.label: Charge
aesthetic-session.section.billing.description: Charge the session; then, the linked invoice with its balance and payments.

aesthetic-session.section.follow-up.label: Aftercare and next appointment
aesthetic-session.section.follow-up.description: Send the aftercare by WhatsApp and schedule the suggested follow-up.

aesthetic-session.btn.activity.label: Activity
aesthetic-session.btn.activity.description: Who did what and when in the session.

aesthetic-session.btn.void.label: Void session
aesthetic-session.btn.void.description: With a reason; it stays read-only, nothing is deleted.

aesthetic-session.btn.close-session.label: Close session
aesthetic-session.btn.close-session.description: Enabled with everything signed, the photo and complete marks.

aesthetic-session.section.amendments.label: Amendments
aesthetic-session.section.amendments.description: Corrections to a closed session, without erasing the original.

patients.field.payment_exchange_rate.label: Exchange rate
patients.field.payment_exchange_rate.description: Units of the primary currency per unit of the secondary one. It comes from the open cash register and can be changed; on a historical payment it has to be typed in.

perio-session.section.header.label: Periodontal chart header
perio-session.section.header.description: Patient, chart number, date and doctor; the four steps, progress and status.

perio-session.btn.step-probe.label: Step 1 · Probing
perio-session.btn.step-probe.description: Depth and bleeding, gingival margin, furcations and mobility (in a screening, the six sextants).

perio-session.btn.step-evolution.label: Step 2 · Progress
perio-session.btn.step-evolution.description: Comparison with the patient's earlier periodontal charts.

perio-session.btn.step-diagnosis.label: Step 3 · Diagnosis
perio-session.btn.step-diagnosis.description: Suggested stability, 2017 classification, risk and plan; the doctor confirms them.

perio-session.btn.step-close.label: Step 4 · Closing
perio-session.btn.step-close.description: Patient report, billing, next visit, notes and signature.

perio-session.section.progress.label: Progress and status
perio-session.section.progress.description: Percentage complete (probing is 90% and the confirmed diagnosis 10%), status of the chart and autosave.

perio-session.btn.missing.label: What is missing
perio-session.btn.missing.description: What is missing to move on. Tap it: it highlights the missing sites in amber or takes you to the next step.

perio-session.section.footer.label: Step footer
perio-session.section.footer.description: Back and next, always in the same place; on the closing step, what is missing to sign.

perio-session.section.banner.label: Exam bar
perio-session.section.banner.description: Exam type, the exam used as a guide, what came from the odontogram, settings and dictation.

perio-session.field.exam-type.label: Exam type
perio-session.field.exam-type.description: Initial diagnosis, re-evaluation or maintenance (full probing); PSR/BPE screening (one code per sextant); implants only (only implants are probed).

perio-session.btn.settings.label: Periodontal chart settings
perio-session.btn.settings.description: The clinic's probing order, margin sign and maintenance intervals. Those who edit the system settings can change them.

perio-session.section.settings.label: Settings
perio-session.section.settings.description: Applies to the whole clinic. Order: by arch or buccal first. Sign: recession positive or negative (stored the same way). Maintenance months per risk.

perio-session.btn.settings-save.label: Save settings
perio-session.btn.settings-save.description: Saves the settings for the whole clinic.

perio-session.section.voice.label: Dictation
perio-session.section.voice.description: What was last understood, the active line of marks, what is pending confirmation, the microphone and the commands.

perio-session.btn.dictate.label: Dictate
perio-session.btn.dictate.description: Turns the microphone on (Chrome or Edge). Each phrase is applied as soon as it is said; “stop dictation” turns it off.

perio-session.field.voice-command.label: Command
perio-session.field.voice-command.description: To type the command instead of dictating it; Enter applies it. The / key brings the focus here.

perio-session.btn.voice-help.label: Voice commands
perio-session.btn.voice-help.description: The list of what can be said, in Spanish and in English.

perio-session.section.voice-pending.label: Pending confirmation
perio-session.section.voice-pending.description: Sites dictated or copied from the previous exam that are not confirmed yet (underlined in violet). The chart cannot be signed with anything pending.

perio-session.btn.voice-confirm.label: Confirm
perio-session.btn.voice-confirm.description: Keeps the dictated or copied values.

perio-session.btn.voice-discard.label: Discard
perio-session.btn.voice-discard.description: Puts every dictated or copied site back as it was.

perio-session.section.passes.label: Passes
perio-session.section.passes.description: The three rounds of probing, each with its progress: depth and bleeding, gingival margin, furcations and mobility.

perio-session.btn.pass-ps.label: Depth and bleeding
perio-session.btn.pass-ps.description: Depth of each site; bleeding, suppuration and plaque with B, S and P.

perio-session.btn.pass-mg.label: Gingival margin
perio-session.btn.pass-mg.description: Margin of each site: positive is recession, negative enlargement (or the other way round, per the settings).

perio-session.btn.pass-fm.label: Furcations and mobility
perio-session.btn.pass-fm.description: Mobility (0 to III) and the furcation grade of each entry, per tooth.

perio-session.btn.copy-ps.label: Start from the previous exam (depth)
perio-session.btn.copy-ps.description: Fills the empty depths, with their bleeding, suppuration and plaque, with the previous exam's. It stays pending confirmation.

perio-session.btn.copy-mg.label: Start from the previous exam (margin)
perio-session.btn.copy-mg.description: Fills the empty margins with the previous exam's. It stays pending confirmation.

perio-session.btn.copy-fm.label: Start from the previous exam (furcations and mobility)
perio-session.btn.copy-fm.description: Fills the missing mobility and furcations with the previous exam's.

perio-session.btn.copy-all.label: Copy everything from the previous exam
perio-session.btn.copy-all.description: The three passes at once. It never overwrites what was measured today.

perio-session.section.focus.label: Which arch is shown
perio-session.section.focus.description: Follows the probe (shows where it is measuring), upper, lower or both. When the arch changes, the view moves by itself.

perio-session.field.show-guide.label: Show the previous exam as a guide
perio-session.field.show-guide.description: Its values in grey in empty cells and its curve dashed. Enter records that value as measured today.

perio-session.btn.undo.label: Undo
perio-session.btn.undo.description: The last change (Ctrl+Z). Redo with Ctrl+Y. Keeps up to 60 steps.

perio-session.section.chart.label: Periodontal chart
perio-session.section.chart.description: Each arch with its outer face on top and its inner face below: blue margin curve, red pocket-bottom curve and the BOP, GM and PD rows. Tap a cell to measure there.

perio-session.section.guide-bar.label: What to record now
perio-session.section.guide-bar.description: The tooth, site and value that goes next, the progress of the pass and the keyboard shortcuts.

perio-session.section.legend.label: Legend
perio-session.section.legend.description: What each colour and symbol of the chart means.

perio-session.section.inspector.label: Inspector
perio-session.section.inspector.description: Exam indicators, the active tooth with its table, the keypad, the tooth history and its note.

perio-session.field.tooth-status.label: Tooth status
perio-session.field.tooth-status.description: Present, missing, pontic or implant. Missing teeth and pontics are not probed.

perio-session.section.tooth-table.label: Tooth table
perio-session.section.tooth-table.description: PD, GM and CAL of each site per face, with the previous value small, and the bleeding, suppuration and plaque buttons.

perio-session.section.keypad.label: Keypad
perio-session.section.keypad.description: Digits, delete, +1, “Same as before” and, on the margin pass, the minus sign.

perio-session.section.marks.label: Marks
perio-session.section.marks.description: Bleeding, suppuration and plaque: they go to the site with the dashed ring (the last one measured or the one you tapped).

perio-session.field.tooth-note.label: Tooth note
perio-session.field.tooth-note.description: Free text for this tooth, for example an X-ray follow-up.

perio-session.section.sextants.label: Sextants
perio-session.section.sextants.description: One code per sextant: that of the worst site (0 to 4, X with fewer than two teeth) and the asterisk. Keyboard: 0–4 or X code it and move on.

perio-session.section.psr-legend.label: PSR/BPE codes
perio-session.section.psr-legend.description: What each code and the asterisk mean.

perio-session.section.evolution-controls.label: How to compare
perio-session.section.evolution-controls.description: Slider, overlay or changes; arch; curves or map; animation.

perio-session.btn.evolution-play.label: Play the progress
perio-session.btn.evolution-play.description: Moves from one exam to the next, from the compared one to today.

perio-session.section.evolution-chart.label: Comparison
perio-session.section.evolution-chart.description: The earlier chart and today's, in the chosen mode.

perio-session.section.compare-with.label: Compare today with…
perio-session.section.compare-with.description: The patient's exams with their date and bleeding; tap one to compare it with today.

perio-session.section.trends.label: Trends
perio-session.section.trends.description: Bleeding, plaque, sites of 5 mm or more, mean PD and CAL in each session, with the difference against the compared exam.

perio-session.section.worse.label: Worse
perio-session.section.worse.description: Sites that lost 2 mm or more of depth or attachment. Tap one to see it.

perio-session.section.better.label: Better
perio-session.section.better.description: Sites that gained 2 mm or more.

perio-session.section.evolution-empty.label: No earlier exam
perio-session.section.evolution-empty.description: It is the patient's first periodontal chart: progress shows from the next one.

perio-session.section.evolution-screenin.label: Codes per session
perio-session.section.evolution-screenin.description: In a screening, the codes of each sextant, session by session.

perio-session.section.dx-today.label: How it is today
perio-session.section.dx-today.description: Stable, stable with inflammation or unstable, with the list that supports it and whether the therapy endpoints are met.

perio-session.section.dx-inputs.label: Data not from the probing
perio-session.section.dx-inputs.description: Teeth lost to periodontitis, X-ray bone loss, age, cigarettes per day and diabetes. They carry over to the next chart.

perio-session.section.dx-classification.label: AAP/EFP 2017 classification
perio-session.section.dx-classification.description: Periodontitis case, stage (from the initial exam; it does not go down), extent and grade, each with its reason. What is changed by hand is marked.

perio-session.section.dx-risk.label: Risk of progression
perio-session.section.dx-risk.description: Lang & Tonetti hexagon with six parameters, the risk and the suggested maintenance interval.

perio-session.section.dx-plan.label: Plan by steps
perio-session.section.dx-plan.description: The EFP steps the probing calls for, each with its checkbox and Today or Later.

perio-session.section.dx-implants.label: Implants
perio-session.section.dx-implants.description: In “implants only”: the suggested status of each implant (healthy, mucositis or peri-implantitis) and the maintenance interval.

perio-session.section.dx-screening.label: Screening result
perio-session.section.dx-screening.description: The highest code, what it means, what to do and which sextants need a full periodontal chart.

perio-session.btn.confirm-diagnosis.label: Confirm diagnosis
perio-session.btn.confirm-diagnosis.description: Puts the diagnosis in the clinical record. It is enabled once probing is complete; if something changes afterwards, it has to be confirmed again.

perio-session.section.report.label: Patient report
perio-session.section.report.description: A summary in plain words: how their gums are, bleeding and pockets against the first check-up, and one tip.

perio-session.btn.report-whatsapp.label: WhatsApp
perio-session.btn.report-whatsapp.description: Opens the message to send it by WhatsApp (needs the patient's phone).

perio-session.btn.report-print.label: Print
perio-session.btn.report-print.description: The report with both arches, ready to print.

perio-session.btn.report-email.label: Send
perio-session.btn.report-email.description: Opens the email with the report (needs the patient's email; uses the PERIO_REPORT_EMAIL template if it exists).

perio-session.section.billing.label: Today's billing
perio-session.section.billing.description: What the plan marks Today; once charged, the linked invoice with its payments.

perio-session.btn.charge.label: Charge
perio-session.btn.charge.description: Opens the billing wizard; the invoice is linked to the periodontal chart.

perio-session.section.next-visit.label: Next visit
perio-session.section.next-visit.description: Reinstrumentation (in 1 to 2 weeks) or maintenance (at the risk interval), with the suggested date.

perio-session.btn.book.label: Book
perio-session.btn.book.description: Opens the schedule with the patient, date and reason filled in.

perio-session.btn.book-later.label: Schedule later
perio-session.btn.book-later.description: Keeps the suggested date; the maintenance reminder uses it.

perio-session.section.notes.label: Session notes
perio-session.section.notes.description: Free text of the periodontal chart.

perio-session.section.indices.label: Today's indices
perio-session.section.indices.description: The ten indicators of the exam (natural teeth).

perio-session.section.checklist.label: What is missing to sign
perio-session.section.checklist.description: Probing, diagnosis, billing, next visit and confirmed dictated or copied values. What is pending can be tapped.

perio-session.btn.sign.label: Sign and close
perio-session.btn.sign.description: Enabled once everything is settled; once closed, it is read-only.

perio-session.btn.sign-confirm.label: Sign and close (confirm)
perio-session.btn.sign-confirm.description: Confirms the signature: the chart goes into the clinical record.

perio-session.section.amendments.label: Amendments
perio-session.section.amendments.description: Corrections of a closed chart: the exam does not change; the text is added with author and date.

perio-session.btn.amend.label: Amend
perio-session.btn.amend.description: Adds an amendment: what is corrected and why.

patients.btn.timeline-open-perio.label: Continue or view periodontal chart
patients.btn.timeline-open-perio.description: Opens the periodontal chart: continue if open, view if closed.

patients.btn.timeline-compare-perio.label: Compare with today
patients.btn.timeline-compare-perio.description: Opens the latest periodontal chart on Progress, compared with this one.

patients.btn.timeline-delete-perio.label: Delete periodontal chart
patients.btn.timeline-delete-perio.description: Only if it is not closed; a closed one is clinical record.
